title: Wildfly: jackson-databind validates the outer class of a class-name type ID but accepts… (CVE-2026-110879)
description: A critical security vulnerability in the Wildfly package involves jackson-databind's handling of class-name type IDs. While it validates the outer class, it improperly accepts attacker-selected classes within generic arguments, even if those classes violate declared types or would normally be rejected. This flaw allows for high-impact exploitation affecting confidentiality, integrity, and availability. Versions prior to 42.0.0-r1 are affected, with a fix available in version 42.0.0-r1.
